captions:
The diary said resting
while the cameras saw
the truck driving.

Albury Local Court,
7 September 2026.
Two counts of false
work diary entries.
Fine: $15,000.

The court called it serious.
The record was made on purpose
to get around fatigue laws.

NHVR advice: think about
electronic work diaries.
Give drivers realistic
schedules with break times.

Source: NHVR court outcomes,
7 September 2026.
